# Sylvi Watches

> > Sylvi is a premium Indian watch brand offering affordable quartz timepieces for men and women, featuring collections like Timegrapher, Professional Edge, Imperial, Gazedoom, and Ocean-X with prices under Rs 3000.

Sylvi specializes in stylish analog watches with water-resistant features, stainless steel and leather straps, and reliable quartz movements. The brand caters to individuals, corporate gifting, and bulk orders for offices and sports teams.

- Quartz Movement Watches
